g.title: O-08-light — Eval inventory (light)
g.desc: /t/acme/observe/evaluations · ?service=checkout-agent&status=failed&range=24h · populated event list with selected row; no-matches, loading and safe error occur at the table position; filters direct-restore from the URL

g.text: Evaluation events, keyed by record_id — run_id is correlation, not identity.
record_id is the event's identity; run_id correlates it with traces, logs and metrics from the same run.
Pasting this URL re-renders all three chips and the same result set.
a run may produce several events.

the reaction — never to an alert editor.

calculated reports; they never substitute for one another.
